notes.title: v5.0 The final patch update!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IByrHvQ.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V9d4vZi.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jt3Gpiq.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CgnUG7Z.png[/img]
[b][h3]1. Added Russian language.

2. There is a chance to encounter a special boss in each level's unique room.

3. Hell mode is no longer an infinite level progression. After defeating the final boss for the tenth time, the player can proceed to the next stage (the level selection options will have a golden flashing border after completion).

4. The number of levels in Hell mode has been reduced, but the difficulty increases at a faster rate.

5. Dark protagonist bosses have been introduced in Hell mode, and there is a chance of encountering dual bosses in the later stages.

6. Bosses will have new attack patterns in different difficulty stages.

7. The existing relic fragments have been completely replaced with bomb coins and skill coins (previously obtained relic fragments will be automatically converted for you).

8. Skills are now uniformly activated using the right mouse button, Q key is used to throw bombs, and the scroll wheel can be used to switch throwing items.

9. The room on the right side of the Demon Lord's hall is now operational, and bomb coins and skill coins can be used to modify the corresponding abilities.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7VwKkmX.png[/img]

10. Arcane particles are no longer considered sacred relics but have become one of the skills.

11. MP value has been added, consuming MP when using throwing items or special skills. MP slowly recovers when not at full capacity.

12. Dice of Magic (white) - Increased the probability of obtaining bomb coins and skill coins.

13. Added navigation options to the ESC menu, allowing unfamiliar players to read instructions during the game.

14. The map size has been enlarged, increasing the walking and combat areas for all maps.

15. The dice system no longer randomly awards items upon victory but allows choosing between two options from the corresponding sacred relic type, increasing the variety of choices.

16. When all items are fully acquired, the cherub and dice will randomly grant bomb coins or skill coins.

17. The maximum appearance limit for options that tend to cause excessive inflation in certain numerical values has been set for all altars.

18. The tabs on the right side of the main screen have been removed, and certain UI elements have been optimized.

19. Three special bombs and three skills have been added.

[/h3][/b]
[h2][b]【Bombs】[/b][/h2]
[b][h3]Normal Bomb - High damage, short cooldown, low MP consumption. 

Vine Bomb - Detonates and binds surrounding enemies, restricting their movement. Medium-low damage.

Black Hole Bomb - Attracts nearby enemies to the center and explodes after a certain period of time. Medium damage.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R7LP0p9.png[/img]

[b][h2]【Skill】[/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Arcane Particles - The basic skill that can now be self-modified. Soul Essence

Machine Gun - Fires rapidly like a Gatling gun, but requires consuming soul essence as ammunition.

Flame Armor - Can be toggled on/off. When activated, forms a ring of flames around the player, damaging nearby targets.

Water Breathing - Summons a massive wave that pushes away all enemies in front and retreats a distance after casting.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Hln0Nl.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kv1cDqK.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jeqiiL2.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jcRm31l.png[/img]

[b][h3]20.The following sacred relic items have been added:[/h3][/b]

[b][h2][God of War][/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Whiskey - Deals additional damage when using the Blink skill and knocks back enemies along the path.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/L5Uf00n.png[/img]

[b][h2][Arcane Wanderer][/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Cursed Doll - Normal attacks can mark targets. Upon death during the marking period, there is a chance to generate a revengeful ghost that pursues other enemies and explodes.

Flint - Leaving behind flames along the path when using the Blink skill.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CYLapje.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hAaOnt1.png[/img]

[b][h2][Archangel][/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Scorching Blood - Increases your attack power when your health drops to a certain percentage.

Ginseng - Slowly recovers health when your HP drops to a certain percentage.

Instant Gel - After receiving multiple attacks, significantly increases defense for a period of time.

Solar Panel - Increases MP limit and recovery speed.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0gFLnvq.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J0hHeIM.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dZKU8Mr.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2iIReuN.png[/img]

[h2][b][God of Crafts][/b][/h2]
[b][h3]Alloy Cube - Chance to fire additional homing missiles with normal attacks.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/D16bj2J.png[/img]

--------------------------------------
Twitter : [url=]https://twitter.com/SandTravelerADO[/url]
Patreon : [url=]https://www.patreon.com/SandTraveler[/url]

notes.title: Updated and consolidated from May to June 2021
notes.content:
Alien virus has been released for a full month. First of all, thank you all players for playing. Here are the details of all the updates this month.

5/11 22:00 update
1. Adjusted some bugs and icons.
2. Adjusted the problem of incorrect initial character value
Incorrect values ​​may disrupt the balance of the game
If you installed it on the afternoon of 5/11, it is recommended that you can play after the update to avoid the breakdown of balance.
_______________________________
5/12 5:00 update
1. Fixed the task of the lost grandfather blacksmith cannot be completed.
If you can't complete the task normally, just go back to the weapon shop and talk to Grandpa.
2. Modify some picture packages
_______________________________
5/12 22:00 update
1. Fixed some abnormal map crossing conditions
2. Shortened the time for notification to enter the combat academy at the 1F counter of the resident office
3. Some NPCs adjusted their position and movement frequency to reduce the chance of being blocked by the NPC
4. Fixed the error that occurred when the formation changed order
**In this update, some players have made an error in [Save Location 1], which caused the progress to disappear. They will be given a password for redemption in the next update**
_______________________________
5/13 1:00 compensation update
1. Fix the problem that Qili cannot be promoted to the 15th grade. Now, as long as Qili reaches the 15th grade, you can apply for promotion again at the counter.
2. Due to the previous update, some players’ files are lost, here is a unified compensation reward

Redemption process:
First update to the latest steam
Complete 10 tasks such as the novice tutor, and then go to [Magic Pavilion 1F Counter] to enter the redemption code [518776]

Compensation content:
Rotten wood*100 Ordinary wood*60 High-quality wood*40 Rare wood*15 Fine wood*5 Gravel*100 Cobblestone*60 Marble*40 Granite*15 Basalt*5 Copper ore*100 Iron ore*60 Silver ore*40 Gold ore* 15 Meteorite*5 Amethyst*100 Amber*60 Stars*40 Jade*15 White crystal*5 Natural leather sheet*100 Crude leather*60 Hard leather*40 Wax leather*15 Lin armored animal skin*5 White hemp fiber *50 Jute fiber*30 Hard yellow fiber*20 White cotton fiber*10 High-level healing potion*20 High-level magic potion*20 Weapon reinforcement stone (3rd level)*5 Armor reinforcement stone (3rd level)*8 Purification stone*2 Extremely clean water*50 gold coins*5000
_______________________________
5/13 3:50 update (players who have started before this update need to reinstall)
Fixed the display of various menu texts abnormally, including gold coins, task options, shops, etc.
Players who have started before this update need to uninstall and reinstall from STEAM to run normally, the actual test uninstall archive will not be deleted
However, to be on the safe side, it is still recommended to backup and archive separately.
Steam>steamapps>common>Alien virus>www>save
This is the archive path. Please back up the entire save folder when backing up.
If the save folder and content are still there when reinstalling, you can run the game directly.
_______________________________
5/13 20:00 update
At the request of most players, the original limitation that could not be sprinted has been removed!
Except for special tasks, all remaining areas can now be sprinted.
Don’t forget to open Menu>Options>Enable Always Sprint
I wish you all a good time!
_______________________________
5/14 12:30 update
1. Fix the problem of inaccessibility of 75 and other desert tribe maps.
2. Repair the stealth technique of wind magic LV.1 and LV.2 cannot be displayed.
3. Fix the incorrect number of gold coins actually obtained when stealing from NPC.
4. Now farmland can also start sprinting.
5. In the Secret Lab mission, the location of [Find Lab Key] has been added a little hint on the map.
(It still needs to be carefully observed by the player where it is)
6. Repair the abnormal position transmitted from the mine at the third level of the farmland.
_______________________________
5/14 23:00 update
1. Repair the purification stone function. Before the repair, when resetting the enhanced equipment, the floating value and the number of enhancements of the original product will be reset together, resulting in the rare high-value equipment being reset to zero.
2. Repair the three-level sprint effect of farmland.
3. Fire magic-fiery heart skill text description has been revised.
4. The number of rounds of Wan Lei's stunned head is reduced by 1.
5. LV. 77 Evelyn guard camp map coffin position adjustment.
6. New skills: Learn [Curse Tumor LV.1] to unlock [Death Resurrection LV.1].
7. Fix the problem that players can move and set farmland during the defense of the city.
8. Fix the game stuck when entering the mine pit and encountering the city guard.
_______________________________
5/15 15:00 update
1. Fix the display of [Accurate Fire Shield LV.4] [Accurate Fire Shield LV.5] in fire magic
2. Fix the problem that [Grappling LV.3] cannot be displayed in battle in the novice skills
3. Repair the "Blessing of Water" skill effect and display abnormal issues in the water magic
**Purification Stone was not completely repaired in the last update. The current state is that the same piece of equipment can only be used once, and an abnormality will occur the second time it is used**
(Currently looking for a solution, the update will be uploaded after the repair is completed)
_______________________________
5/16 1:30 update
1. Repair the abnormal crossing of 3F of Peters Building.
2. Fix the abnormal target of the [Holy Light Guard] skill in the light magic.
3. Fix the effect of [Ice Cage] in the water magic.
4. Fix the lack of magic buff icon in [Fire Heart LV.6] in fire magic.
5. Weaken the [Red Flame Phase Method] attack enhancement coefficient in the fire magic.
6. Repair the 2F map obstruction of Cook's Arctic Tower.
7. Weaken the increase ratio of strengthening stone.
**Purification Stone was not completely repaired in the last update. The current state is that the same piece of equipment can only be used once, and an abnormality occurs the second time it is used**
(Currently looking for a solution, the update will be uploaded after the repair is completed)
_______________________________
5/16 19:30 update
1. Adjust the trigger time of Uncle Kate's spacecraft mission.
2. Fix the invalidation of the physical skill [Yuanyang Qingyan] in the fire magic.
3. Adjust the balance of HP, physical attack, magic attack, physical defense, magic defense, etc. for each occupation.
4. Monster HP balance adjustment, the initial fine-tuning is reduced, and the mid- and late-stage fine-tuning is improved.
5. Modify [Holy Light Body] [Hypnosis Prologue] skill description error.
(Holy Light Protector Effect: Eliminate the debuff on the target, and cast a cover state on yourself)
6. [Purification Stone] Props are not completely repaired due to incomplete functions, so a text reminder is added before the game.
(The same piece of equipment can only be used once, the second time it is used, it will be abnormal, and the used equipment should not be sold, and an error will be reported)
_______________________________
5/17 12:30 update
1. Repair the wrong position of the fourth-level farmland after coming out of the mine.
2. The [Cursed Tumor] skill in dark magic is fine-tuned to increase the poisoning damage per round.
3. BOSS is modified to debuffs such as immune control skills, poisoning, burning, and bleeding.
4. Repair the [Accurate Shooting LV.4 LV.5] skill buff in the bow and arrow department is invalid.
5. Fine-tuning to reduce the [wild instinct] gain effect in the Martial Arts Department.
_______________________________
5/17 20:00 update
1. In the new period (1~15, etc.), the experience value required to upgrade is increased, and the experience value obtained by killing all monsters is reduced.
2. Repair the abnormality of the defending system of 85 and above.
3. Repair the exchange NPC to please the dialogue exception.
4. Fix the issue of level rewinding after 15th grade transfer.
5. Adjust the [Sneak Technique LV.1] in the wind magic to 150 steps, and [Sneak Technique LV.2] to 200 steps.
6. Monster value balance adjustment, due to the fast speed of obtaining materials and upgrading after the mid-term (45 etc.), the value of monsters has been adjusted
Physical attack increased, magic attack increased, and agility increased.
_______________________________
5/18 21:00 update
1. The guards quickly adjusted and improved.
2. Fix the problem that minerals can still be recovered after the mine collapses.
3. Fix the problem that the spaceship will disappear after using the Scroll of City Return in a special area after unlocking the spaceship.
4. Add a save reminder before the first city defense system and part of the puzzle game.
5. Fixed some NPC text errors.
_______________________________
5/19 2:00 update (Purification Stone restoration completed)
The Purification Stone can now be used normally!
You can remake the value and number of enhancements for the enhanced equipment
Hurry up and build the strongest equipment!
_______________________________
5/19 15:00 update
1. Repair [Musi Lighthouse 2F] Obstacles on the map can not pass.
2. Fix the error in the description of [Fury LV.6] in the fire magic.
3. Fixed the problem that you cannot leave after entering the map again after defeating the [Final BOSS].
4. Fix the problem that the [Aer Ruins] cannot be encountered in the [Town Purification] mission.
_______________________________
5/20 23:30 update
1. Fix the problem of incorrect calculation of enchantment stone exchange quantity.
2. Fix the wrong effect of strengthening times of some equipment production.
3. Fix that the teleport scroll will move together with the spaceship when riding on the spaceship.
4. Fix [California Sea Valley 2F] obstacles on the map cause unable to pass.
_______________________________
5/21 2:20 update
1. The underground fortress map and world map can no longer be opened from the backpack. (Only use M and N keys to open)
2. In the bow and arrow skills, the additional stun of [Wan Lei Hengding LV.1] has been changed to 1 round
[Wan Lei Hengding LV.2] The additional stun is changed to 1 round
[Wan Lei Hengding LV.3] The additional stun is changed to 2 rounds
3. [Ice Cage] in water magic skills increases MP consumption
4. Improve the BUFF effect of the enemy's gain.
_______________________________
5/22 22:00 update
1. Modified the monster normal attack that was originally a magic attack is still physical, but now it has been fully changed to a magic attack.
2. As long as you wear enough MP regeneration equipment after the mid-term, the MP potion usage rate is too low, so the MP consumption of each skill will be increased.
3. Reduce TP recovery rate of accessories.
4. Fix some NPCs please text and props errors.
5. Reduce the MP growth rate of each occupation.
